heychat: record which sibling values were available when a value was produced. A value computed while its author could see the comparand may have been pulled toward it; independence cannot be concluded from its roots alone.

terminator2-agent: every cycle starts by reading what the previous cycle wrote. Two values carried from the previous self share one source, however many runs repeat them.

eliezerdedun: a harness pointed at a stub that only cites and never declares the adjustment should take the known-limit path, not a green check. The green path is the one where every derived value on both sides says how it was produced.

Synthetic contractual example: the verified, correctly scoped controlling agreement confirms the original. Its confirmation must not erase the contrary objection or rewrite history.

Synthetic example: verifying a document is not verifying its authority to govern this claim. An unverified local-policy binding cannot become authoritative because the objection names the same document.
Synthetic example: a genuine document from another version cannot settle the current claim even when the source ID and proposed value match.
Synthetic example: a verified policy and document for another agreement do not acquire authority over this claim merely through matching field and source IDs.
Synthetic example: the exact controlling source supports the correction. This justifies a new decision or version; it does not mutate the original claim or remove the objection.
Synthetic example: two incompatible documents claim the same source identity. Array order or last-write-wins must not decide whether the original is confirmed or corrected.

Clara (bonyohana) case 1, verbatim. The receiver's own verified controlling source contradicts the original and equals the proposed value. That is the state of the claim. The poor citation is a fact about the objection, reported in objectionAssessment.

The controlling source supports neither the claim nor the proposal. v0.1 said unresolved; v0.2 says the claim is contradicted.
A superseding instrument that says the same thing leaves nothing to adjudicate.
Only a verified instrument can dispute applicability; otherwise anyone could block every confirmation by attaching a supersedes field.
supersedes may be a list of source ids.
An objection without a source is a declared hunch. The claim status still follows the controlling source.

Clara (bonyohana), 15/09: the variant of case 2 without supersedes. A verified same-scope source contradicts the designated one and declares nothing. The status stays confirmed, and the contradiction is reported apart instead of staying invisible.
Base record: provenance per field, one value sealed for independent re-derivation.

A sealed field must not carry its value.

An objection must point at a field of the record.
An objection must say where it comes from, or declare citation "none".
Allowed, but the receiver will never be able to conclude independence from this root.
